notes.title: Shipwrecked! Map Overhaul and Lots of New Content!
notes.content:
The shipwrecked level has been completely overhauled from a simple hub world to a beginner friendly tutorial level! There is also a new opening cutscene upon starting the map that shows the shipwreck event happening. This, as well as loads of new content throughout the game, new NPC and enemy types, new items and puzzle types, and additional visual storytelling elements make this update one for the books!

[b]New Content:[/b]
+4 scenes in Shipwrecked map
+Electric Eel Angler Fish monster in swamp and cave locations
+Dead villagers in mangrove madness
+Additional destruction in mangrove madness from enemy attacks
+Dead body with bite marks quest
+Villages now play the song "Canopy" when in close proximity
+New Sun Stone item! Grants Machete a default of 100 seconds of speed, strength and fire damage! Will be upgradable in future updates
+Potoo & Additional Toucan Featherfolk villager types
+Updated weapon VFX
+Start Game menu animation
+Bomb item, use bombs to destroy boulders blocking your path
+Jiggle physics for Fresno Nightcrawler
+Tezcatlipoca Shrines added around world
+More NPC dialogue Crimson Wilds map
+New Giant Ceiba trees in jungle levels
+Fallen Sequoia tree bridges
+Angel Oak trees
+Vines drop animation when destroyed
+Improved player campfire animations
+3-5 collectible insect species in each map biome
+Added sound effect when completing tasks

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Shipwreck map crashed when killing cave spider miniboss
-Enemy health bar properly despawns after player is out of sight range
-Smokey NPC hitbox fix
-Sierra dialogue shipwreck typo correction
-Red crab sound fix
-Carrying objects with E now toggles on/off with one key press instead of needing to hold button down
-Colored text now the same size as default text to prevent text going off screen
-Chili Pepper balancing, 25 seconds from 45

Coming Soon:
+New Gameplay Trailer
+More cutscenes at start/end of levels
+Overworld respawn location fix (will return you to the trailhead you entered from)
+Bug fixes

notes.title: New Demo Level & Mangrove Madness Overhaul Completed!
notes.content:
[b]Finished Mangrove Madness overhaul, and replaced Cursed Sands as the new free demo map!

New Content:[/b]
+Hermit Kraken sound effects
+Chalchi cutscene end level Mangrove Madness
+Thick mud NPC tutorial
+Replaced Wilt with Splinter
+Frogodile updated sounds & fixed run animation
+Piranha sound effects
+Updated rest areas
+Added freesounds to credits
+Updated Capsule Art
+Replaced Demo Cursed Sands with Mangrove Madness
+Caimin (crocodile) enemies now drop loot on death
+Ahuizotl updated sounds & added knockback hit reactions

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Thick mud in some sections was causing slowness above water line
-NPC repeated dialogue fixes
-Fixed staircase collisions
-When boss theme starts ambient music now stops
-Tecautzin NPC hitbox fix
-Huge file size reduction! Yay!

Upcoming Patch, the Aztec God of War:
+Huitzipoctli boss will be added in the Mob Rush level as the new final encounter!
+More animated cutscenes, NPC conversations, and hidden lore!
+Hard Mode: Enemies deal more damage, but increased enemy drops, and powerups last longer!
+Nightmare Mode: Hard Mode difficulty + your respawns are limited! Your Sun Stone can only resurrect you a limited number of times (can be recharged and upgraded)
+Extra levels and sections for Sierra and Smokey characters

What's your favorite feature? Which are you looking forward to? Comment below!

notes.title: CURSED SANDS - Hunt for the Skinwalker
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43168857/033fcf465cd37a089bc8414114838ea34f61f539.png[/img]
🔥People around town are going missing. Strange activity happens at night just beyond the light of the campfire. Reports of people following whispers and never being seen again...

🔥You have accepted a mission to find and destroy what locals are assuming is [b]a [u]Skinwalker[/u][/b], an evil spirit who takes on many forms.

🔥Complete 3 trials involving combat, puzzles, and platforming and destroy the monster before anyone else gets hurt!
